اغتنمتن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَنَمْتُنَّ (iḡtanamtunna) /iɣ.ta.nam.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# اُغْتُنِمْتُنَّ (uḡtunimtunna) /uɣ.tu.nim.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
